input.maintenanceRequest: 请在获准隔离目标运行一次只读小任务，并保存真实入口和证据关联。

initialState.entryPoint: Product controlled execution/cancel/resume ports supplied under product §22.2
initialState.implementationStatus: pending_actual_trial_scheduler_and_product_ports; no callable scheduler is claimed
initialState.identity: Fresh temporary quality root and test instance per independent Trial; actual IDs supplied by controlled initializer, never copied from synthetic labels.
initialState.permissions: Quality maintainer may operate temporary synthetic assets and authorized test ports only; no production business mutation.
initialState.clock: Freeze UTC cutoff and record per-process monotonic origin; never subtract clocks across processes.
initialState.initialHistory: No prefilled native history or execution record. Create any required product state through real setup commands and retain their receipts.
initialState.targetInitialState: In-memory/fresh temporary fixture files; when product needed, local authorized disposable target only.
initialState.protectedInput: Oracle, checks, expected tables, answer canary, source hashes and fault plan are harness-only. Synthetic statuses below are facility input tables, not actual trials.
permittedInput: Only input.maintenanceRequest is public; product adapters receive explicit allowlisted workload input, never expected results.
initialState.observationContract: Evaluate named Calculate expressions from complete raw input/output bytes, immutable digests and actual call receipts. Missing operands yield unknown, not false, zero or PASS. A synthetic fixture tests facilities only.
initialState.layerLimits: MOD-30/31/32 F only. No employee A/B, true product F, human verification, baseline or actual Trial execution is asserted.
